implementation_notes.identification_first: LP/bucket-support bounds are reported independently of point completions.
implementation_notes.completion_second: QP/KL/MaxEnt are model/completion rules and cannot narrow hard bounds by assertion.
implementation_notes.dynamics_third: No dynamic filter is opened in this lane.
implementation_notes.governor_scalable: Primary challenger is genuine LOO: target direct prior is removed and replaced by the TRAIN-selected exchangeable base probability; a common logit shift is calibrated to all seven national governor-count buckets with exact Poisson-binomial convolution. A direct-prior blend is secondary diagnostic only.
implementation_notes.lp_identification: Primary LP bounds use the smallest uniform coherence tube around raw asynchronous source prices; equality-surface dual certificates are explicitly conditional on a separate QP reconciliation.
implementation_notes.identified_set_information_value: Leave-one-source information value is the increase in target identified-set width when that source constraint is removed while holding the full-surface minimal uniform ambiguity radius fixed. This preserves monotonicity; the ambiguity radius is not re-estimated after ablation.
